items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Eleanor Powell and W.C. Fields, Dorothy Donnegan -- and you were with Woody Herman's band and I was in Cab Calloway's band

ctx.x: 1945. Eleanor Powell and W.C. Fields, Dorothy Donnegan -- and you were with Woody Herman's band and I was in Cab Calloway's band, and Chubby Jackson was your base player, and I was playing the base with Cab Calloway, and we used to go backstage and have us a nice taste out of our bottles, because we had to bring our bottles.
There was a drummer that I always loved --
